failure_conditions: Any mandatory critical gate is FAIL or BLOCKED at release decision time.
Frozen lint corpus SHA-256 differs from cc23a138f8a8c4b8d1985a8cde6e4177d9185d7c01f1f777eced3a462d729b7d.
Any of the 50 seeded defect cases misses its expected LINT-001..LINT-010 finding.
Any of the 50 seeded clean cases emits an unsuppressed finding.
Any emitted corpus finding lacks an exact source span, line/column, or rationale.
Any per-rule precision is below 1.0 on the frozen corpus.
An unapproved or unknown suppression decision hides a finding.
A legitimate append-only successor record invalidates an unchanged historical release prefix.
A mutation inside a preserved historical prefix or immutable version-local artifact is accepted.
Any applicable inherited regression fails or disappears without approved retirement.
The evaluator actor is also an implementation actor.
Missing evaluation cases or missing denominator data are treated as zero or complete evidence.

hash_scope: Canonical UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators, excluding the contract_hash property.
promotion_conditions: All mandatory gates PASS; accepted risk may only apply to explicitly noncritical documentary limitations.
All primary and guardrail metrics meet frozen targets and reconcile to raw events and denominator snapshots.
All applicable regressions REG-0001 through REG-0004 PASS and any newly discovered meaningful defect is considered for permanent regression memory.
Frozen corpus and evaluation-plan hashes remain intact.
Independent evaluator recommendation is recorded and evaluator differs from implementation actor.
Release manifest and rollback declaration are complete.

Because evaluation is synthetic, the maximum release classification for this candidate is PROMOTED AS EXPERIMENTAL unless independent real-project evidence is added under a separately preregistered contract.

requirements.description: Provide deterministic context scanning that excludes fenced code, blockquotes, Notes:, and Rationale: from active prose linting.
Implement LINT-001 vague/non-testable normative language detection with exact phrase span.
Implement requirement-block rules LINT-002 missing acceptance, LINT-003 critical failure behavior, and LINT-006 missing verification.
Implement LINT-004 unresolved critical decision detection.
Implement LINT-005 undefined interface/entity reference detection.
Implement LINT-007 deterministic constraint contradiction detection with related source location.
Implement LINT-008 task-breadth and LINT-009 component-boundary detection.
Every lint finding contains rule ID, severity, line, column, exact source span, and rationale in deterministic order.
Implement local suppression requiring an explicitly supplied approved DEC-* identifier; unapproved suppression cannot silently hide findings.
Expose linter through importable Python API and CLI human/JSON modes with nonzero exit on unsuppressed errors while preserving validate compatibility.

Provide deterministic evaluator that refuses frozen evaluation-plan hash d397f59d72cf83df246beb41a59931b67d8d15d3bd850dce8fc2e2be4925fbc4 or corpus hash cc23a138f8a8c4b8d1985a8cde6e4177d9185d7c01f1f777eced3a462d729b7d drift and computes preregistered metrics.
Preserve inherited active regressions REG-0001 through REG-0004 and the v0.03 validator suite.
Historical release-manifest verification must remain valid after legitimate appends to shared append-only ledgers while detecting historical-prefix and immutable-artifact mutation.

rollback_expectations.expectation: If v0.04 fails, v0.03 remains the active promoted-experimental parent. Preserve all v0.04 failed evidence, the original v0.04 frozen contract, and all prior release artifacts without rewriting history.
